pins.name: DomainSentinel
pins.text: DomainSentinel is a Telegram bot designed to monitor domain lists for updates, providing real-time notifications to subscribed users. It automatically checks domain changes from various sources, processes WHOIS data, and ensures users are alerted promptly about any domain additions or removals.
